summary: bumpRateLimit now uses a conflict-safe check-and-set retry loop, preventing concurrent requests from acting on the same stale counter, and the new regression test exercises 50 concurrent bumps against a limit of 5.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts lines 1465-1482 read the bucket and commit the increment only when the versionstamp check succeeds, retrying conflicts.
The retry loop re-reads the bucket on conflict and preserves windowStart while reapplying the windowMs expiry.
tests/bun_test.ts lines 74-86 issue 50 concurrent bumps against a limit of 5 and assert that exactly 5 succeed.
